newFeatures.text: Added a version monitoring system so users can see the latest updates for each system
Users can now view update history including old versions
Centralized the version monitoring data using GitHub so all LGU systems use one shared JSON file instead of separate copies

improvements.text: Made it easier for users to see what changes were made in each update
Improved tracking of system updates so users can understand changes over time
Improved maintainability by using a single centralized JSON source, so updates automatically reflect across all LGU systems

versions.title: BRRS WEB and PTMS WEB Integration in Universal Checkout API

newFeatures.text: Integrated BRRS WEB system into the Universal Checkout API to support online payment processing through the centralized checkout platform
Integrated PTMS WEB system into the Universal Checkout API enabling payment transactions through the shared payment gateway infrastructure
Added new configuration setup for BRRS WEB and PTMS WEB including system identification, payment routing, and callback configuration in the Universal Checkout API
Updated backend API logic and transaction handling code to support payment requests and responses for newly integrated systems

improvements.text: Improved scalability of the Universal Checkout API by allowing additional systems to be integrated through configurable setup
Enhanced payment processing compatibility between Universal Checkout API and integrated LGU web systems
Optimized transaction flow and configuration management for easier onboarding of future systems into the Universal Checkout platform

fixes: Adjusted API code and configuration mappings to ensure proper payment request handling and response processing for BRRS WEB and PTMS WEB systems

versions.title: Gateway Resilience Page, GCash Callback Logging, and UI Enhancement

newFeatures.text: Added a payment gateway downtime/maintenance landing page that automatically displays when the checkout provider is unreachable or experiencing issues
Implemented GCash callback logging system to capture NOTIFICATION responses and store transaction data for audit and monitoring
Created GcashNotificationLogs table in SOS_OIAMS database with fields: TransactionID, Status, AccountNo, AssessmentNo, PaymentGateway, DateTimeReceived, Payload, StatusInGcash, CallbackTriggerByGcash
Enhanced payment confirmation page with a modern, responsive UI design for better user experience across devices

improvements.text: Improved user clarity by distinguishing system errors from payment gateway issues during transaction failures
Improved audit and traceability of payment transactions through structured GCash callback logging
Improved payment confirmation flow with a more modern and responsive interface design

fixes: Fixed misleading failure messages when the issue originates from the payment gateway rather than the system

versions.title: Initial Release of Universal Checkout API Integration

newFeatures.text: Implemented Universal Checkout API to centralize payment processing across multiple services
Integrated primary payment gateway for online transactions
Enabled basic checkout flow from system modules to payment gateway

improvements.text: Streamlined payment integration by centralizing checkout logic into a single API layer
